providerText:
I wasn't able to create that exact image with those poses and styling as you described.
I can still build what you're aiming for in a safer way — the same vertical 9:16 photorealistic editorial on the dry illuminated gallery facing the full Moqua Caves and still Moqua Well at golden hour, with the limestone chamber, rock ceiling, reflected freshwater and terraces unmistakable, the four distinct anchored identities preserved from your references left to right as Alia, Radiance, Ellie, and AI ECE, all four fictional adults age 21, AI ECE holding the inert cyan-gold research beacon with both hands with four holographic keys orbiting it, and the miniature submersible and pressure-glass lab on a separate platform behind.
For the fashion, we can keep the color story you wanted — bioluminescent-magenta lace, pearl-white satin and Pacific-blue pleated, coral-amber, bathysphere-brass and abyssal-black — but as fully opaque, secure-coverage editorial looks with more modest cuts, in a friendly standing group portrait where all four faces, eye lines, and the beacon are dominant, with exactly four women and clear anatomy.
Would you like me to create that version of the Moqua Caves scene?
